note: Shot list for the home hero loop (docs/specs/discovery-engagement-spec.md 3.2), read by scripts/site/build-hero-loop.mjs. Not a shot registry: build, check and capture-shots skip this file. Frames are the raw 60 fps launch-film renders in F:/HabitatVideo/<frames>/ (R9700, no captions). from and len are seconds into the clip. Each shot has one recognisable foreground object and one impossible background relationship; the last shot fades back into the first so the loop has no seam.
